data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 7 observations; candidates: unknown

observations.finding: Treated fields show markedly lower confluence than DMSO control f_ad322e23a39f (same contrast). DMSO: large continuous epithelial sheet with >100 nuclei/field. Treated: scattered small clusters of 2-15 cells, large empty background. Indicates reduced cell number / growth inhibition.
Nuclei (blue, f_d895c52d8595, f_15134fd3aeec, f_97117b6cf921, f_36cefc6cf5bc) are on average slightly smaller and more compact than uniform oval DMSO nuclei.
Interphase nuclei show increased shape irregularity: less round/oval, lobed and indented contours vs smooth oval DMSO nuclei. Indicates decreased circularity and increased concavities.

Population heterogeneity: majority small nuclei plus occasional markedly enlarged, multilobed or bi-nucleate cells and bright round yellow-white condensed-chromosome cells (blue+green overlap, e.g. f_d895c52d8595 top row, f_36cefc6cf5bc center and top-right). Rare in DMSO.

F-actin (red) in treated clusters appears brighter and more heterogeneous than DMSO: strong cortical red rim with spiky retraction fibers and variable intensity between cells vs more uniform cortical red in DMSO sheet. Indicates increased mean intensity, variance and texture contrast.

Beta-tubulin (green) interphase network remains present, no obvious global depolymerization or bundling at this resolution. Few rounded cells show intense diffuse/ spindle-like green signal overlapping condensed DNA (yellow). Overall microtubule organization not dramatically altered.
Small number of detached, highly rounded mitotic/apoptotic-like cells with condensed DNA and intense tubulin/actin co-staining present in all four treated fields, slightly above DMSO background.

notable_cells.why: bright yellow-white rounded cell with condensed chromatin, intense tubulin+actin overlap - example of mitotic-like cell driving actin heterogeneity

candidate_mechanisms.why: Visible phenotype is general cytotoxicity/stress: reduced density, small irregular nuclei with rare enlarged/multilobed nuclei, increased/broadened cortical actin intensity and contrast, and few rounded mitotic-like cells. No hallmark actin collapse (Actin disruptors), no extensive microtubule loss (Microtubule destabilizers) or bundles (Microtubule stabilizers), no massive polyploidy (>10% large nuclei) typical of Aurora/Eg5 inhibition at this dose. Measurements confirm strong nuclear shape changes (nuc_form_factor z=-20.85, nuc_solidity z=-12.98, nuc_area z=-7.88, nuc_major_axis z=-7.74, frac_large_nucleus z=5.60) and actin changes (act_glcm_contrast z=9.82, act_std z=7.45, act_mean z=6.09) but these are non-specific. No stain supports a listed class; do not guess compound.

report.uncertainty: Only composites available without grayscale quantification; actin tubulin intensity judged by color overlap at fixed contrast.

Agrees with cell_roundness z=-2.228 (0.514 vs 0.534) and cell_solidity z=-2.96 (0.821 vs 0.832), both |z|<3 weak decreases indicating more irregular, less compact cells - exactly as seen.

Agrees with act_std z=2.315 (0.102 vs 0.092) and act_glcm_contrast z=2.472 (0.002 vs 0.002) - both |z|<3 weak increases in heterogeneity/contrast. Visual increase subtle, no depolymerization.
Beta-tubulin green only from composite: green filamentous network intact, similar radial fibers as DMSO. No obvious depolymerization, bundling, or monopolar spindles.
Not covered by measurements: no tubulin features in top_deviations. No evidence for Microtubule destabilizers/stabilizers or Eg5 inhibitors.

DNA blue only from composite: DAPI intensity not obviously increased; if anything slightly fainter. 1-2 bright white-yellow condensed mitotic nuclei per field similar to DMSO, no binucleation/multinucleation or large polyploid nuclei.

Consistent with nuc_dna_integrated z=-2.303 (359 vs 393) |z|<3 weak decrease - no DNA accumulation. No support for Aurora, DNA damage/replication classes at this resolution without grayscale channels.

bright actin-rich dot with condensed chromatin - mitotic/apoptotic, isolated
large flat cell with intense green tubulin and red rim - example of spread irregular cell driving increased eccentricity/decreased solidity

candidate_mechanisms.why: Only 2/8 measured features exceed |z|>3 and absolute deltas tiny (form_factor 0.011, eccentricity 0.048). Pattern is subtle elongated nuclei + spiky less-round cells with intact tubulin and retained/increased actin - opposite of Actin disruptors (would lose red), opposite of Microtubule stabilizers/destabilizers (no bundling/loss), no Aurora/Eg5 multinucleation. Does not match any listed strong signature with confidence at 1.0 uM, 170 cells, composites only, no grayscale quantification.

report.uncertainty: Low contrast composite only; grayscale channels not provided so intensity/texture assessment limited. Phenotype weak, may be assay noise or early cytotoxic scatter rather than specific MoA.
